outcome: placental protein 13 (PP13) levels in syncytiotrophoblast extracellular vesicles (STB-EVs)
cohort: Women with and without preeclampsia who underwent cesarean section
finding: Women with preeclampsia had significantly lower levels of PP13 in their STB-EVs compared to women without preeclampsia, potentially indicating impaired placental communication with maternal organs.
gest_age: Not specified, but potentially a confounding factor
